reason: The cited evidence shows precipitation hardening in a Ti-rich medium-entropy alloy (E1) and general thermomechanical processing benefits (E3), but none addresses AlCoCrFeNi-based HEAs, coherent nano-precipitates, or their role in corrosion/oxidation passivation. The key premises linking precipitates to simultaneous mechanical and environmental enhancements are unsupported by the provided passages.
premises: Controlled heat-treatment can induce uniform coherent nano-precipitates in AlCoCrFeNi-based HEAs modified with Ti or V
Coherent nano-precipitates enhance yield strength via precipitation hardening
Coherent nano-precipitates improve corrosion resistance by serving as sites for protective passivation layers
Coherent nano-precipitates improve high-temperature oxidation resistance by promoting stable oxide films
The beneficial effects diminish with over-aging or coarsening above ~1000 °C
